text:
Maya (Support): Customer on iOS 17.2 reports SSE stopped mid-response; client saw TCP FIN after ~18s of silence. Trace id: trace-5a9f
Jordan (SRE): Can you paste the request + response headers from their capture?
Maya (Support): They attached the request headers:
```http
GET /v1/stream HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx
Accept: text/event-stream
User-Agent: MyApp/2.3.1 (iOS)
```
Maya (Support): They claim server sent keepalive comments every 10s but app closed at ~18s.
Anya (Eng): iOS background kills sockets, but this was foreground. Any wifi->cell handover?
Maya (Support): Customer said stable wifi. App logs show a network-change event ~2s after the close, maybe delayed.
Jordan (SRE): Pulling edge logs for trace-5a9f now. Looking for FIN/RST or proxy timeouts.
DevOps Bot: Edge log excerpt for trace-5a9f:
```text
2025-06-10T12:34:56Z trace=trace-5a9f conn=12345 event=comment_sent
2025-06-10T12:35:06Z trace=trace-5a9f conn=12345 event=no_data_seen
2025-06-10T12:35:14Z trace=trace-5a9f conn=12345 event=proxy_sent_rst reason=idle_timeout
```
Anya (Eng): Proxy RST at ~18s matches their client FIN window. Likely LB/edge idle clamp or NAT timeout.
Ryan (Support): Customer worried about being billed for partial output — they saw a truncated JSON chunk.
Maya (Support): Yes, they were billed for tokens up to abort. They asked if we can credit them.
Jordan (SRE): For repro: ask them to run raw `curl -N` and capture tcpdump/pcap. Example command to give them:
```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream > out.txt
sudo tcpdump -i any -w dump.pcap host api.redwood.ai and port 443
```
Anya (Eng): Also ask them to keep a small client-side keepalive comment every 5s as a short-term workaround.
Jordan (SRE): Long-term we should: 1) audit LB idle settings (I think a recent change lowered it to 16s), 2) add jittered server pings/comments at ~8s to avoid synchronized clamping, 3) surface `x-edge-event` headers in logs.
Maya (Support): I've given the customer the curl repro steps and the workaround. Asked for tcpdump and app logs.
DevOps Bot: Config change detected: lb/edge/idle_timeout set -> 16s (change-id: cfg-782). Rollback in progress.
Anya (Eng): If cfg-782 rolled back to 30s, that should reduce these RSTs. We'll still add defensive keepalives in runtime.
Ryan (Support): For billing: recommend crediting this session if infra confirms premature RST.
Maya (Support): I'll hold on credit until SRE confirms. Updating customer now :thumbsup:
